subject: Node onboarding runbook + capacity escrow check — Helion Nexus (late-stage)
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Node onboarding runbook + capacity escrow check — Helion Nexus (late-stage)

Folks,

Quick context: Helion Nexus (HLN-2027-0045) is at final legal/PO stage. Their expected production go-live window is the week of 7/25. Sales needs a short internal confirmation that we can (a) reserve the right set of nodes and GPUs for their rollout and (b) publish a minimal node-onboarding runbook so CS and SRE can onboard without surprises.

Ask: can ops provide a short inventory snapshot plus proposed node mapping and whether we can offer a 30-day capacity escrow (soft reserve) for the core fleet they'll need? Key constraints: Helion requires 10 sustained A100 80GB-equivalent slots with KV cache warming during the first 2 weeks. If A100s are constrained, they have requested a quantized A10G fallback but want latency guarantees called out.

Please respond with:
- a succinct inventory snapshot (available nodes by GPU type / region)
- a recommended node mapping (how many nodes, instance sizes)
- id of any nodes we should earmark for escrow and suggested ops play (canary, telemetry hooks)
- blockers/risks and an ETA for a short onboarding runbook draft (2–3 pages)

Target: need a plan by EOD Fri 7/16 to align with legal and sales.

Thanks,
Markus
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: requirements_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Node onboarding runbook + capacity escrow check — Helion Nexus (late-stage)

On Fri, Jul 16, 2027 at 09:21 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:
> Folks,
> Quick context: Helion Nexus (HLN-2027-0045) is at final legal/PO stage...

Thanks Markus — quick inventory snapshot below (pulled 07/16 09:55 PT). Full CSV attached.

Inventory snapshot (us-west1 regional pool, production):
- A100 80GB (prod pool): total 48, free 6 (usable without rebalancing)
- A100 80GB (staging pool, can be prepped): total 12, free 8 (requires 24h reprovision ops window)
- A10G (quantized path): total 120, free 90 (good for cost-sensitive fallback)
- T4 / lower-tier: available but NOT suitable for their KV/cache needs

Recommendation:
- Primary: earmark 10 A100 80GB nodes — 6 from prod free pool + 4 reprovisioned from staging. This requires a 24–36h reprovision lead and a brief rolling maintenance window.
- Fallback: define a quantized A10G profile (latency SLO: 20–40% higher median p95 compared to A100) and provide a clear degraded SLO in the runbook.
- Canary: allocate 2 nodes (A100) for canary traffic with tracing hooks + token-level cost telemetry.

Attachments: fleet_snapshot_20270716.csv (contains per-node ids, gpu type, zone, last-used timestamp).

Blockers / risks:
- If Helion insists on immovable pinned A100 instances in a specific AZ, capacity is tight — we will need legal to accept an "equivalent capacity" clause.
- Reprovisioning staging nodes to prod will consume a short ops blackout; schedule must be coordinated with infra.

ETA for onboarding runbook draft: I can produce a 2–3 page draft by EOD Mon 7/19 if we lock the target node list now. If we need something sooner (by 7/18), I can do a condensed one-page checklist this weekend.

—Mina
Senior Production Architect, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: fleet_snapshot_20270716.csv (CSV)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Jul 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Node onboarding runbook + capacity escrow check — Helion Nexus (late-stage)

On Fri, Jul 16, 2027 at 10:12 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com> wrote:
> Inventory snapshot (us-west1 regional pool, production): ...

Adding ops/contract context from a deal-ops perspective.

1) Proposed escrow approach: we should offer a 30-day soft-capacity escrow that reserves node ids from the staging pool and marks them "earmarked" in our allocation ledger. This would be reversible if the deal stalls but gives Helion the commercial comfort they want. Recommend earmarking 12 nodes (10 active + 2 canary).

2) Commercial guardrails: finance needs a short clause — "reserved nodes will be invoiced at 50% of posted unit rate if not consumed after 30 days, otherwise consumption billing applies" — this protects us from long holds. Legal to draft.

3) Ops playbook suggestions for onboarding runbook (I can draft a PDF):
   - Pre-provision step list (node prep, disk staging, SSH key push)
   - KV cache warm-up script + expected cold->warm token delta (estimated 15–18% extra cost first 48h)
   - Canary checklist (traffic split, metric thresholds, rollback triggers)
   - Post-onboard telemetry (latency heatmap for first 72h)

I've attached a node_mapping_draft.pdf (2 pages) that maps requested capacity to specific node ids and zones. If we lock those ids we can give Helion a firm start date.

Marissa
Director, Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: node_mapping_draft.pdf (PDF)]

From: Tara Singh <tara@helionnexus.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Helion Nexus Infra <infra@helionnexus.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Node onboarding runbook + capacity escrow check — Helion Nexus (late-stage)

Thanks Markus / Mina / Marissa — this is helpful.

Helion confirms we want the 30-day soft escrow. We agree to the commercial guardrail (50% invoiced if unused) — legal will sign the MOU once you push the doc. Our preferred start date is 2027-07-25; can you confirm the earmarked node ids and whether there are any blackout windows the week prior that would block the reprovisioning?

Also, please include a short note in the runbook on how we can test KV cache warm-up from our side (we'd like a reproducible script). If you can deliver the one-page checklist by 7/18 EOD and the 2–3 page runbook by 7/19 EOD that aligns with our internal timelines for deployment planning.

Tara Singh
Head of Platform, Helion Nexus
[tara@helionnexus.com]
